name: LZG International, Inc.
summary: LZG International, Inc. operates within the insurance ecosystem services market, where it specializes in the development, management, and distribution of software as a service (SaaS) and software as a business (SaaB) solutions. The company, which was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, originally operated under the name LazyGrocer.Com, Inc. before officially rebranding to LZG International, Inc. in August 2009.
